answer: A bond of 51% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in river, and shale reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 59 aliases, and each one needs its own funded ocean account. A farm of 4451 identities would post 791 proofs and burn roughly 81 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
